title: Fruit Flavored Drink Powder with High Vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: The fruit flavored drink powder with high vitamin C is designed for quick preparation of a refreshing beverage. The powder does not require pre‑mixing and can be added directly to water or another liquid. Its taste resembles a blend of citrus and berries, and the high vitamin C content makes it a beneficial addition to the diet.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The powdered format allows long‑term storage without loss of flavor.
Vitamin C is stabilized to retain its properties even after extended shelf life.
The product contains no sugar, but can be sweetened according to personal preference.
It is often used by athletes and travelers as a fast source of vitamins.
The powder is easy to transport, does not spill, and does not require refrigeration.

items.title: High vitamin C content
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: Adding the powder to water makes it more palatable, encouraging fluid intake.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Vitamin C participates in iron metabolism and helps convert food into energy.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Antioxidants protect cells from oxidative stress, which is especially important during physical activity.

items.title: Convenient usage
items.content: The powder is easy to dose, allowing precise control of vitamin intake.

items.title: Allergy to fruit flavorings
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to the flavoring components.

items.title: Excessive vitamin C intake
items.content: Very high doses of vitamin C can cause gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Vitamin C may affect the efficacy of certain drugs, such as anticoagulants.

items.title: Not suitable for young children
items.content: Due to the high concentration of vitamin C, dosage for children should be monitored.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add one‑two servings (as indicated on the package) of powder to a glass of cold water, stir thoroughly until fully dissolved. Optionally, add ice, mint, or a splash of juice to enhance flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the packet in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to prevent moisture ingress.
